caption: The drawing depicts a textile design composed mainly of red, greenish-beige, and white colors. The pattern is arranged in a grid format, alternating between red and greenish-beige squares. Inside the red squares, white motifs are visible, including two large eagle-like birds with pronounced wings, a circular marking on their bodies, positioned above ornate baskets or urns. Surrounding these birds are symmetrical arrangements of eight-pointed star shapes. The greenish-beige squares contain white motifs of stylized urns with tree-like forms rising from them, also surrounded by white star shapes. Along the left edge runs a vertical border made up of smaller square patterns containing geometric shapes, such as diamonds and triangles, in both greenish-beige and red. The lower edge features a similarly styled horizontal strip. The overall design is highly repetitive and symmetrical, with each motif and pattern closely packed together to form a continuous decorative fabric.
title: Commemorative Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
